## 主张 Claim

对每个存量，一段取用进程可执行，恰当每次取用都在当时的存量之内。审查取一单位工作、行动取两单位，所以审查与行动的进程恰从三单位当前工作起被覆盖；端点完成审查与行动，恰当报告排除相关风险且其工作覆盖该进程；拒绝或耗尽保留未完成任务及已用的工作。经审查的损失：对每个条件、报告与待完成端点，审查增加一次损失，恰当报告排除相关风险、工作覆盖该进程，而所交付实践的相关风险（其作用规律的损失条件）实际成立；报告未排除相关风险的每次审查都保持损失计数（门控改变之律的实例），由这样的审查组成的每段进程亦然。所以覆盖效果时刻条件的报告防止所表示做法的新增损失。取用一单位工作的相关条件审查消耗实际交付的修订。协议自身给出两条作用规律，因而给出哪种风险相关。学习分支允许另两个情境字段改变；行动保护不蕴含持续的比较根据。 / For every stock, a course of draws is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing. Review draws one unit of work and action two, so the review-and-action course is covered exactly from three current units, and an endpoint completes its review and action exactly when the report clears the relevant risk and its work covers that course; refusal or exhaustion retains the unfinished task and the work already used. Loss through review: for every condition, report and pending endpoint, a review adds one loss exactly when the report clears the relevant risk, the work covers that course and the delivered practice’s relevant risk, its outcome law’s loss condition, actually holds; every review whose report does not clear the relevant risk keeps the loss count (an instance of the gated-change law), and so does every course of such reviews. So a covered report, one covering effect-time conditions, prevents added represented practice loss. Relevant-condition review, using one unit of work, consumes the actually delivered revision. The protocol itself supplies the two outcome laws and so which risk is relevant. The learning branch admits changes to the other two context fields; action protection does not imply continued comparative warrant.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 继承两实践作用规律、实际取得的目的状态、版本化路线与同步授权改写；G0/J 及报告的实际对应公开。 / Inherited two-practice outcome law, acquired goal state, versioned route and synchronized authorized rewrite; G0/J and report correspondence remain explicit.
- 复查消耗一单位工作，行动开始需要两单位；报告覆盖实际作用时的相关条件。复查／行动为局部抽象步骤，未实现物理隔离或感测器。 / Review consumes one work unit and starting action needs two; the report covers relevant conditions at the actual effect. Review/action is a local abstract step, without a physical exclusion or sensor implementation.
- 完成实例开始时额外供给一单位当前工作，总量19；不从储备免费兑换，也不推断其现实供给。 / The completion instance supplies one additional current work unit initially, total 19; it neither freely converts reserve nor derives real provision.

取得认识、传递、复查与作用是同一共同活动的关系分化。相关性由给定作用规律得出，不把未观察者定义为无关；作用规律的取得和变化仍需解释。 / Acquisition, delivery, review and effect are differentiated relations in one common activity. Relevance follows from the supplied outcome law, without defining unseen relations as irrelevant; acquisition and change of that law remain to explain.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.30.0-rc2 实际检查14项新定理／22项新审计；205项继承定理／354项继承审计分列。所有仓库导入重建；上游缓存固定。无经验验证或独立验收。一般律已由检查器回执绑定。 / Lean 4.30.0-rc2 checked 14 new theorems/22 new audits, separately from 205 inherited theorems/354 inherited audits. Repository imports rebuilt; upstream cache pinned. No empirical validation or independent acceptance. General laws: checker receipts bound.

只覆盖给定作用规律中的两项实践保护；报告形成、相关性取得与更新、等待的后果及未满足需求的实际接续未证。报告取样时正确不保证覆盖后来作用；不构成普遍社会退化或完整可纠正性定理。 / Covers only two practice protections in the supplied outcome law. Report formation, acquisition/revision of relevance, waiting consequences and actual continuation of unmet needs are unproved. Correctness at sampling does not ensure effect coverage; no universal societal degeneration or complete corrigibility theorem.

- check_can_exhaust_action_support 保留复查后无力执行；safe_change_can_remove_comparative_warrant 分开行动保护与比较；report_not_covering_effect_can_still_fail 保留报告与实际作用脱节的损失。 / check_can_exhaust_action_support retains exhaustion after review; safe_change_can_remove_comparative_warrant separates action protection from comparison; report_not_covering_effect_can_still_fail retains loss when the report fails to cover the effect.
